methods.comment: * Print help text for the command.

methods.name: public String nextOption()
methods.comment:
* Return the next option on the command line -- that is an argument that
     * starts with '-'.  If the next argument is not an option, null is returned.

methods.name: public String nextArg()
methods.comment:
* Return the next argument on the command line, whatever it is; if there are
     * no arguments left, return null.

methods.name: public String peekNextArg()
methods.comment:
* Peek the next argument on the command line, whatever it is; if there are
     * no arguments left, return null.

methods.name: public String nextArgRequired()
methods.comment:
* Return the next argument on the command line, whatever it is; if there are
     * no arguments left, throws an IllegalArgumentException to report this to the user.

methods.name: public String[] getRawArgs()
methods.comment: * Return the original raw argument list supplied to the command.
